files.data:
--! id: filemgr
--! name: 文件管理器
--! version: 1.7

-- 文件管理器：设备本地小应用分区 + 电脑共享目录（SMB 由网关代读）
-- 可用 API：ui.*、net.get/post、fs.list/read/size/remove（固件 2.9.10 起，remove 2.9.39 起）、
--   sys.env/log/exit、sys.set_wallpaper（2.9.31 起）；sys.ota_flash / sys.app_reset / sys.app_write（2.9.33 起）、
--   sys.lib（2.9.54 起加载公共库 /assets/apps/.lib/<名>.lua）
-- 安装：.lua 单文件包可在本应用内长按「安装为小应用」（脚本头部 --! 元数据），
--   共享目录文件夹含 app.json 亦可安装；.bin 可直接刷机
-- 键盘：左右移动 / 翻页，语音键打开，左长按返回上级，右长按文件信息（含删除），电源键退出

local W, H = ui.size()
local TOP = ui.content_top()
local LH = ui.line_height()
local MARGIN = 16

local TEXT_W = W - MARGIN * 2
local LIST_TOP = TOP + 42
local LIST_BOTTOM = H - 56
local ROW_H = LH + 10
local ROWS = math.max(1, math.floor((LIST_BOTTOM - LIST_TOP) / ROW_H))
local TEXT_ROWS = math.max(1, math.floor((LIST_BOTTOM - LIST_TOP) / LH))
local CHAR = (utf8 and utf8.charpattern) or "."
local TAB = "\t"

local ROOTS = {
  { id = "dev", name = "设备存储", hint = "小应用分区 /apps 内的文件" },
  { id = "smb", name = "共享空间", hint = "电脑共享目录（SMB，经网关读取）" },
}

local TEXT_EXT = {
  txt = 1, md = 1, lua = 1, json = 1, log = 1, ini = 1, cfg = 1, conf = 1,
  csv = 1, yaml = 1, yml = 1, js = 1, c = 1, h = 1, cpp = 1,
}
local IMAGE_EXT = { pbm = 1, png = 1, jpg = 1, jpeg = 1, bmp = 1, webp = 1, gif = 1 }

local view = "home"          -- home | list | text | image | info | confirm | del_confirm | msg | error
local sel = 1
local root_id = "dev"
local dir_path = ""
local crumbs = {}            -- 进入目录前的父路径，左长按逐级返回
local entries = {}
local error_text = ""

local info_item = nil        -- 文件信息页当前条目
local info_path = ""
local info_actions = {}      -- 可选动作（设为壁纸 / 更新系统固件 / 安装当前小应用）
local info_sel = 1
local msg_text = ""          -- 操作结果提示页

local image_pbm = nil
local image_name = ""

local reader = nil           -- { text, name, start, next_at, history = {} }

-- ===== 通用 =====

local function quote(text)
  local out = ""
  for i = 1, #text do
    local ch = string.char(text:byte(i))
    if ch:match("[A-Za-z0-9%-%._~]") then
      out = out .. ch
    else
      out = out .. string.format("%%%02X", text:byte(i))
    end
  end
  return out
end

local function fetch(path, timeout)
  local base = sys.env("gateway")
  if not base then return nil, "未配置网关地址" end
  if base:sub(-1) == "/" then base = base:sub(1, -2) end
  local url = base .. path
  local token = sys.env("token")
  if token then
    url = url .. (path:find("?", 1, true) and "&token=" or "?token=") .. token
  end
  local body, err = net.get(url, timeout or 20000)
  if not body then return nil, err or "网络请求失败" end
  if body:sub(1, 4) == "ERR " then return nil, body:sub(5) end
  return body
end

-- 副作用操作（删除）走 POST：网关约定 body 恒为空，结果仍是文本行协议
local function fetch_post(path)
  local base = sys.env("gateway")
  if not base then return nil, "未配置网关地址" end
  if base:sub(-1) == "/" then base = base:sub(1, -2) end
  local url = base .. path
  local token = sys.env("token")
  if token then
    url = url .. (path:find("?", 1, true) and "&token=" or "?token=") .. token
  end
  local body, err = net.post(url, "", "text/plain")
  if not body then return nil, err or "网络请求失败" end
  if body:sub(1, 4) == "ERR " then return nil, body:sub(5) end
  return body
end

-- 等待网络时先画「加载中」并立即刷新：用局刷，避免整屏黑白翻转闪烁
local function show_loading(title, line)
  ui.clear()
  ui.title(title)
  ui.center("加载中…", TOP + 150)
  if line then ui.center(line, TOP + 190) end
  ui.footer("请稍候 · 电源退出")
  ui.flush()
end

local function base_name(path)
  return path:match("([^/]+)$") or path
end

local function fit(text, width)
  if ui.measure(text) <= width then return text end
  local out = ""
  for ch in text:gmatch(CHAR) do
    if ui.measure(out .. ch .. "…") > width then break end
    out = out .. ch
  end
  return out .. "…"
end

local function size_text(bytes)
  if bytes < 1024 then return tostring(bytes) .. "B" end
  if bytes < 1048576 then return string.format("%.1fK", bytes / 1024) end
  return string.format("%.1fM", bytes / 1048576)
end

-- ===== 分区占用（主页存储项） =====

-- 设备分区容量来自固件 fs.usage（2.9.63 起）；共享空间在电脑端，网关暂无统计接口
local function usage_of(root)
  if root ~= "dev" or not (fs and fs.usage) then return nil end
  local used, total = fs.usage()
  if used and total and total > 0 then return used, total end
  return nil
end

-- 黑条上重绘文字：整字落在黑条内的部分用白字（反色），条外文字保持原来的黑字
local function invert_over_bar(text, x, y, bar_end)
  local pos, cx, head = 1, x, ""
  while pos <= #text do
    local ch = text:match(CHAR, pos) or text:sub(pos, pos)
    local w = ui.measure(ch)
    if cx + w > bar_end then break end
    head = head .. ch
    cx = cx + w
    pos = pos + #ch
  end
  if head ~= "" then ui.text_inv(head, x, y, math.max(1, bar_end - x + 4)) end
end

-- 递归统计文件夹大小：设备本地直接遍历；共享空间走网关 list，
-- 限制目录数与文件数（8 个目录 / 300 个文件），超限标记“部分”避免长时间等待
local function dir_size(path)
  local total, count = 0, 0
  if root_id == "dev" then
    local guard = 0
    local function walk(dir, depth)
      if depth > 6 or guard > 300 then return end
      local body = fs.list(dir)
      if not body then return end
      for line in body:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        local kind, name, size = line:match("^(.)" .. TAB .. "([^" .. TAB .. "]*)" .. TAB .. "(%d+)$")
        if kind == "f" then
          total = total + (tonumber(size) or 0)
          count = count + 1
        elseif kind == "d" then
          guard = guard + 1
          walk(dir == "" and name or (dir .. "/" .. name), depth + 1)
        end
      end
    end
    walk(path, 0)
    return total, false
  end

  local queue, head, dirs, partial = { path }, 1, 0, false
  while head <= #queue do
    if dirs >= 8 then partial = true; break end
    local cur = queue[head]
    head = head + 1
    dirs = dirs + 1
    local body = fetch("/device/files/list?path=" .. quote(cur))
    if not body then partial = true; break end
    for line in body:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
      local kind, name, size = line:match("^(.)" .. TAB .. "([^" .. TAB .. "]*)" .. TAB .. "(%d+)$")
      if kind == "f" then
        total = total + (tonumber(size) or 0)
        count = count + 1
      elseif kind == "d" then
        queue[#queue + 1] = cur == "" and name or (cur .. "/" .. name)
      end
    end
    if count > 300 then partial = true; break end
  end
  return total, partial
end

local function ext_of(name)
  return (name:match("(%w+)$") or ""):lower()
end

local function load_entries()
  local body, err
  if root_id == "dev" then
    if not fs then return nil, "固件不支持 fs API（需 2.9.10 及以上）" end
    body, err = fs.list(dir_path)
  else
    body, err = fetch("/device/files/list?path=" .. quote(dir_path))
  end
  if not body then return nil, err or "读取失败" end

  local out = {}
  for line in body:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
    local kind, name, size = line:match("^(.)" .. TAB .. "([^" .. TAB .. "]*)" .. TAB .. "(%d+)$")
    if kind then
      out[#out + 1] = { kind = kind, name = name, size = tonumber(size) or 0 }
    end
  end
  return out
end

-- ===== 列表 =====

local function dir_title()
  if dir_path == "" then
    return root_id == "dev" and "设备存储" or "共享空间"
  end
  return (root_id == "dev" and "设备 · " or "共享 · ") .. base_name(dir_path)
end

-- 小应用缓存文件没有扩展名（c_<key>），按命名给出可读标签：
--   c_c<hash><w>x<h> 封面缓存、c_p<hash><nnn> 漫画页缓存、c_fav/c_hist 收藏与历史
local function cache_label(name)
  local w, h = name:match("^c_c[0-9a-f]+(%d+)x(%d+)$")
  if w then return "封面 " .. w .. "×" .. h end
  local n = name:match("^c_p[0-9a-f]+(%d%d%d)$")
  if n then return "漫画页 " .. tostring(tonumber(n) + 1) end
  if name == "c_fav" then return "收藏数据" end
  if name == "c_hist" then return "历史数据" end
  return "缓存 " .. name
end

local function is_cache_name(name)
  return name:sub(1, 2) == "c_"
end

local function draw_frame(x, y, w, h)
  ui.rect(x, y, w, h, false)
  ui.rect(x + 2, y + 2, w - 4, h - 4, false)
end

local function draw_home()
  ui.clear()
  ui.title("文件管理器")
  local top = TOP + 34
  ui.text("选择存储位置：", MARGIN, top, TEXT_W)
  local row_h = LH * 2 + 20
  local list_y = top + LH + 14
  for i = 1, #ROOTS do
    local root = ROOTS[i]
    local y = list_y + (i - 1) * row_h
    local row_w = W - MARGIN * 2
    local row_inner = row_h - 4
    local used, total = usage_of(root.id)
    local detail = root.hint
    local bar_end = nil
    if used then
      local pct = math.floor(used * 100 / total + 0.5)
      detail = string.format("已用 %d%% · %s / %s", pct, size_text(used), size_text(total))
      bar_end = MARGIN + 3 + math.floor((row_w - 6) * used / total)
    end
    ui.text(root.name, MARGIN + 12, y + 4, row_w - 24)
    ui.text(detail, MARGIN + 12, y + 4 + LH, row_w - 24)
    if bar_end and bar_end > MARGIN + 3 then
      -- 列表项内部用黑色填充已用空间，填充区覆盖到的文字重绘为白字（反色）
      ui.rect(MARGIN + 3, y + 3, bar_end - MARGIN - 3, row_inner - 6, true)
      invert_over_bar(root.name, MARGIN + 12, y + 4, bar_end)
      invert_over_bar(detail, MARGIN + 12, y + 4 + LH, bar_end)
    end
    if i == sel then draw_frame(MARGIN, y, row_w, row_inner) end
  end
  ui.footer("语音进入 · 左右选择 · 电源退出")
end

local function draw_list()
  ui.clear()
  ui.title(dir_title())
  local first = 1
  if #entries > ROWS then
    first = math.max(1, math.min(sel - ROWS + 1, #entries - ROWS + 1))
  end
  for i = 1, math.min(ROWS, #entries) do
    local item = entries[first + i - 1]
    if item then
      local y = LIST_TOP + (i - 1) * ROW_H
      local label = item.kind == "d" and (item.name .. "/")
        or (is_cache_name(item.name) and cache_label(item.name) or item.name)
      local right = item.kind == "f" and size_text(item.size) or ""
      local right_w = right ~= "" and ui.measure(right) or 0
      local name_w = TEXT_W - right_w - (right ~= "" and 12 or 0)
      ui.text(fit(label, name_w), MARGIN, y + 4, name_w)
      if right ~= "" then
        ui.text(right, W - MARGIN - right_w, y + 4, right_w + 4)
      end
      if first + i - 1 == sel then
        draw_frame(MARGIN - 4, y - 3, W - MARGIN * 2 + 8, ROW_H - 2)
      end
    end
  end
  -- 右侧滑动条：内容超出屏宽时提示下方还有多少内容，滑块位置对应当前窗口
  if #entries > ROWS then
    local track_x = W - 6
    local track_h = LIST_BOTTOM - LIST_TOP
    ui.rect(track_x, LIST_TOP, 1, track_h, false)
    local thumb_h = math.max(18, math.floor(track_h * ROWS / #entries))
    local max_off = #entries - ROWS
    local thumb_y = LIST_TOP + math.floor((track_h - thumb_h) * (first - 1) / max_off)
    ui.rect(track_x - 1, thumb_y, 3, thumb_h, true)
  end
  if #entries == 0 then
    ui.center("（空目录）", LIST_TOP + 40)
  end
  ui.footer("语音打开 · 左长按上级 · 右长按信息")
end

local function refresh_list(loading)
  if loading then show_loading("文件管理器", "正在读取目录…") end
  local list, err = load_entries()
  if not list then
    error_text = err or "读取失败"
    view = "error"
    return
  end
  entries = list
  sel = 1
  view = "list"
end

-- ===== 文本阅读 =====

-- 从 pos 起取一行：按像素宽度断行，\t 按两个空格，返回行文本与下一位置
local function take_line(text, pos)
  if text:sub(pos, pos) == "\n" then pos = pos + 1 end
  local out = ""
  while pos <= #text do
    local ch = text:match(CHAR, pos) or text:sub(pos, pos)
    if ch == "\n" then
      pos = pos + 1
      break
    elseif ch == "\r" then
      pos = pos + 1
    elseif ch == "\t" then
      if out ~= "" and ui.measure(out .. "  ") > TEXT_W then break end
      out = out .. "  "
      pos = pos + 1
    else
      if out ~= "" and ui.measure(out .. ch) > TEXT_W then break end
      out = out .. ch
      pos = pos + #ch
    end
  end
  return out, pos
end

local function draw_text()
  ui.clear()
  ui.title(reader.name)
  local pos = reader.start
  local lines = {}
  local guard = 0
  while #lines < TEXT_ROWS and pos <= #reader.text and guard < TEXT_ROWS + 4 do
    local line, next_pos = take_line(reader.text, pos)
    guard = guard + 1
    if next_pos == pos then break end
    pos = next_pos
    lines[#lines + 1] = line
  end
  reader.next_at = pos
  for i = 1, #lines do
    ui.text(lines[i], MARGIN, LIST_TOP + (i - 1) * LH, TEXT_W)
  end
  if #lines == 0 then ui.center("（空文件）", LIST_TOP + 40) end
  local page = #reader.history + 1
  local tail = pos > #reader.text and " · 已到末尾" or ""
  ui.footer("第 " .. page .. " 页" .. tail .. " · 左右翻页 · 左长按返回")
end

local function normalize_text(body)
  body = body:gsub("\r\n", "\n"):gsub("\r", "\n")
  if body:sub(1, 3) == "\239\187\191" then body = body:sub(4) end
  return body
end

local function open_text(path, name)
  show_loading("文件管理器", "正在打开 " .. name .. "…")
  local body, err
  if root_id == "dev" then
    if not fs then
      error_text = "固件不支持 fs API（需 2.9.10 及以上）"
      view = "error"
      return
    end
    body, err = fs.read(path)
  else
    body, err = fetch("/device/files/text?path=" .. quote(path), 30000)
  end
  if not body then
    error_text = err or "读取失败"
    view = "error"
    return
  end
  if body:find(string.char(0), 1, true) then
    error_text = "这不是文本文件"
    view = "error"
    return
  end
  reader = { text = normalize_text(body), name = name, start = 1, next_at = 1, history = {} }
  view = "text"
end

local function turn_text(step)
  if not reader then return end
  if step > 0 then
    if reader.next_at > #reader.text then return end
    reader.history[#reader.history + 1] = reader.start
    reader.start = reader.next_at
  else
    local prev = table.remove(reader.history)
    if not prev then return end
    -- 只调整页起点，下一次框架重绘 draw_text() 时会重新计算 next_at
    reader.start = prev
  end
end

-- ===== 图片 =====

local function draw_image()
  ui.clear()
  if not image_pbm or not ui.image(image_pbm, 0, TOP) then
    ui.center("图片无法显示", TOP + 80)
  end
  ui.footer(fit(image_name, W - 40) .. " · 语音键返回")
end

local function open_image(path, name)
  show_loading("文件管理器", "正在打开 " .. name .. "…")
  local body, err
  if root_id == "dev" then
    if not fs then
      error_text = "固件不支持 fs API（需 2.9.10 及以上）"
      view = "error"
      return
    end
    body, err = fs.read(path)
    if body and body:sub(1, 2) ~= "P4" then
      error_text = "设备端只能预览 PBM 图片（PNG/JPG 请从共享目录打开）"
      view = "error"
      return
    end
  else
    body, err = fetch("/device/files/image?path=" .. quote(path) .. "&w=480&h=700", 45000)
    if body and body:sub(1, 2) ~= "P4" then
      error_text = err or "图片格式不支持"
      view = "error"
      return
    end
  end
  if not body then
    error_text = err or "读取失败"
    view = "error"
    return
  end
  image_pbm = body
  image_name = name
  view = "image"
end

-- ===== 文件信息（列表页右长按进入） =====

local function type_text(item)
  if item.kind == "d" then return "目录" end
  local ext = ext_of(item.name)
  if ext == "pbm" then return "PBM 图片" end
  if ext == "bin" then return "固件包" end
  if IMAGE_EXT[ext] then return "图片" end
  if TEXT_EXT[ext] then return "文本" end
  if is_cache_name(item.name) then return "应用缓存" end
  return "未知类型"
end

-- 只有设备能直接显示的图才允许设壁纸：设备存储要 PBM，
-- 共享空间任意图片可经网关转成 480×800 PBM 后下发
local function wallpaper_capable(item)
  if item.kind ~= "f" then return false end
  if root_id == "dev" then return ext_of(item.name) == "pbm" end
  return IMAGE_EXT[ext_of(item.name)] ~= nil
end

local function open_info()
  local item = entries[sel]
  if not item then return end
  info_item = item
  info_path = dir_path == "" and item.name or (dir_path .. "/" .. item.name)
  info_actions = {}
  if wallpaper_capable(item) then
    info_actions[#info_actions + 1] = { kind = "wallpaper", label = "设为壁纸" }
    info_actions[#info_actions + 1] = { kind = "poweroff", label = "设为关机壁纸" }
  end
  if item.kind == "f" and ext_of(item.name) == "bin" then
    -- 固件包：确认后经 sys.ota_flash 流式写入备用分区，完成后自动重启
    info_actions[#info_actions + 1] = { kind = "flash", label = "更新系统固件" }
  end
  if item.kind == "d" and root_id == "smb" then
    -- 共享目录里的文件夹可作为小应用安装（设备存储里的文件夹本来就已就位）
    info_actions[#info_actions + 1] = { kind = "install", label = "安装当前小应用" }
  end
  if item.kind == "f" and ext_of(item.name) == "lua" then
    -- .lua 单文件包：脚本头部 --! 元数据即安装信息，长按即装（2.9.54 起）
    info_actions[#info_actions + 1] = { kind = "install_lua", label = "安装为小应用" }
  end
  -- 删除：文件与文件夹都支持，进确认页防误删
  info_actions[#info_actions + 1] = {
    kind = "delete",
    label = item.kind == "d" and "删除该文件夹" or "删除该文件",
  }
  -- 文件夹没有现成字节数：进入信息页前递归统计（共享空间限目录/文件数，超限标“+”）
  item.dir_bytes, item.dir_partial = nil, false
  if item.kind == "d" then
    show_loading("文件信息", "正在统计文件夹大小…")
    item.dir_bytes, item.dir_partial = dir_size(info_path)
  end
  info_sel = 1
  view = "info"
end

local function draw_info()
  ui.clear()
  ui.title("文件信息")
  local size_label
  if info_item.kind == "f" then
    size_label = size_text(info_item.size)
  elseif info_item.dir_bytes then
    size_label = size_text(info_item.dir_bytes) .. (info_item.dir_partial and "+" or "") ..
                  "（含子项）"
  else
    size_label = "--"
  end
  local rows = {
    { "名称", info_item.name },
    { "类型", type_text(info_item) },
    { "大小", size_label },
    { "位置", fit(info_path, TEXT_W - 68) },
  }
  local y = TOP + 36
  for i = 1, #rows do
    ui.text(rows[i][1], MARGIN, y, TEXT_W)
    ui.text(rows[i][2], MARGIN + 68, y, TEXT_W - 68)
    y = y + LH + 14
  end
  y = y + 12
  if #info_actions == 0 then
    local hint = "该条目没有可用操作"
    if info_item.kind == "d" and root_id == "dev" then
      hint = "设备上的文件夹无需安装"
    end
    ui.text(hint, MARGIN, y, TEXT_W)
  else
    for i = 1, #info_actions do
      local ry = y + (i - 1) * (LH + 16)
      ui.text(info_actions[i].label, MARGIN + 12, ry + 4, TEXT_W - 24)
      if i == info_sel then draw_frame(MARGIN, ry, W - MARGIN * 2, LH + 12) end

-- ===== 安装小应用（共享目录文件夹 → sys.app_reset/app_write） =====

-- app.json 内容很简单，用 pattern 抽字段即可（沙箱没有 JSON 库）
local function meta_field(text, key)
  return text:match('"' .. key .. '"%s*:%s*"([^"]*)"')
end

local function install_app()
  if not (sys.app_reset and sys.app_write) then
    msg_text = "固件版本过低（需 2.9.33 及以上）"
    view = "msg"
    return
  end

  -- 1. 列出文件夹内容：要求平铺（无子文件夹），且不能太大
  show_loading("安装小应用", "正在读取目录…")
  local body, err = fetch("/device/files/list?path=" .. quote(info_path))
  if not body then
    msg_text = "读取目录失败：" .. (err or "未知错误")
    view = "msg"
    return
  end
  local files = {}
  local dir_count = 0
  for line in body:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
    local kind, name, size = line:match("^(.)" .. TAB .. "([^" .. TAB .. "]*)" .. TAB .. "(%d+)$")
    if kind == "f" then
      files[#files + 1] = { name = name, size = tonumber(size) or 0 }
    elseif kind == "d" then
      dir_count = dir_count + 1
    end
  end
  if dir_count > 0 then
    msg_text = "目录包含子文件夹，暂不支持安装"
    view = "msg"
    return
  end
  if #files == 0 then
    msg_text = "目录为空，不是小应用"
    view = "msg"
    return
  end
  if #files > 64 then
    msg_text = "文件过多（" .. #files .. " 个），不支持安装"
    view = "msg"
    return
  end

  -- 2. 读 app.json 确定 id / 入口
  local meta_raw
  for _, f in ipairs(files) do
    if f.name == "app.json" then
      meta_raw = fetch("/device/files/raw?path=" .. quote(info_path .. "/app.json"))
      break
    end
  end
  if not meta_raw then
    msg_text = "不是小应用（缺少 app.json）"
    view = "msg"
    return
  end
  local app_id = meta_field(meta_raw, "id") or ""
  local app_name = meta_field(meta_raw, "name")
  local app_ver = meta_field(meta_raw, "version") or "1.0"
  local entry = meta_field(meta_raw, "entry")
  entry = (entry ~= nil and entry ~= "") and entry or "main.lua"
  if app_id == "" or #app_id > 16 or not app_id:match("^[a-z0-9_%-]+$") then
    msg_text = "app.json 的 id 非法\n（限小写字母/数字/_/-，≤16 字符）"
    view = "msg"
    return
  end
  local entry_ok = false
  for _, f in ipairs(files) do
    if f.name == entry then
      entry_ok = true
      break
    end
  end
  if not entry_ok then
    msg_text = "入口脚本缺失：" .. entry
    view = "msg"
    return
  end

  -- 3. 清掉旧程序文件（store/缓存等用户数据保留），再逐文件下载写入
  show_loading("安装小应用", app_name or app_id)
  local ok, werr = sys.app_reset(app_id)
  if not ok then
    msg_text = "清理失败：" .. (werr or "未知错误")
    view = "msg"
    return
  end
  local written = 0
  for _, f in ipairs(files) do
    local data, ferr = fetch("/device/files/raw?path=" .. quote(info_path .. "/" .. f.name), 30000)
    if not data then
      msg_text = "读取失败：" .. f.name .. "\n" .. (ferr or "未知错误") .. "\n重新安装即可修复"
      view = "msg"
      return
    end
    local wok, werr2 = sys.app_write(app_id, f.name, data)
    if not wok then
      msg_text = "写入失败：" .. (werr2 or f.name)
      view = "msg"
      return
    end
    written = written + 1
  end
  msg_text = "已安装 " .. (app_name or app_id) .. " v" .. app_ver ..
    "\n共 " .. written .. " 个文件\n在「小应用管理」查看"
  view = "msg"
end

-- ===== 安装 .lua 单文件包（脚本头部 --! 元数据 → sys.app_reset/app_write） =====

-- 解析脚本头部 --! key: value 元数据块：只扫到第一行普通代码为止，
-- 普通注释行跳过（元数据行形如 "--! id: manbanshi"）
local function parse_pkg_meta(code)
  local meta = {}
  for line in code:gmatch("([^\r\n]+)") do
    local key, value = line:match("^%s*%-%-!%s*([%a_]+)%s*:%s*(.-)%s*$")
    if key then
      meta[key] = value
    elseif line:match("%S") and not line:match("^%s*%-%-") then
      break
    end
  end
  return meta
end

-- JSON 字符串转义（应用名可能含引号/反斜杠）
local function json_str(text)
  return '"' .. text:gsub('[\\"]', "\\%0") .. '"'
end

local function install_app_lua()
  if not (sys.app_reset and sys.app_write) then
    msg_text = "固件版本过低（需 2.9.33 及以上）"
    view = "msg"
    return
  end
  if info_item.size > 96 * 1024 then
    msg_text = "脚本超过 96KB，无法安装"
    view = "msg"
    return
  end
  show_loading("安装小应用", "正在读取脚本…")
  local code, err
  if root_id == "dev" then
    code, err = fs.read(info_path)
  else
    code, err = fetch("/device/files/raw?path=" .. quote(info_path), 30000)
  end
  if not code then
    msg_text = "读取失败：" .. (err or "未知错误")
    view = "msg"
    return
  end
  local meta = parse_pkg_meta(code)
  local app_id = meta.id or ""
  if app_id == "" or #app_id > 16 or not app_id:match("^[a-z0-9_%-]+$") then
    msg_text = "脚本头部缺少 --! id: 或 id 非法\n（限小写字母/数字/_/-，≤16 字符）"
    view = "msg"
    return
  end
  local app_name = meta.name or app_id
  local app_ver = meta.version or "1.0"
  show_loading("安装小应用", app_name)
  local ok, werr = sys.app_reset(app_id)
  if not ok then
    msg_text = "清理失败：" .. (werr or "未知错误")
    view = "msg"
    return
  end
  local wok, werr2 = sys.app_write(app_id, "main.lua", code)
  if not wok then
    msg_text = "写入失败：" .. (werr2 or "main.lua")
    view = "msg"
    return
  end
  -- app.json 由脚本头部元数据自动生成：版本号真源始终在 .lua 文件内
  local app_json = '{"id":' .. json_str(app_id) .. ',"name":' .. json_str(app_name) ..
    ',"version":' .. json_str(app_ver) .. ',"entry":"main.lua"}'
  local jok, jerr = sys.app_write(app_id, "app.json", app_json)
  if not jok then
    msg_text = "app.json 写入失败：" .. (jerr or "未知错误")
    view = "msg"
    return
  end
  msg_text = "已安装 " .. app_name .. " v" .. app_ver .. "\n在「小应用管理」查看"
  view = "msg"
end

-- ===== 打开条目 =====

local function open_entry()
  local item = entries[sel]
  if not item then return end
  if item.kind == "d" then
    crumbs[#crumbs + 1] = dir_path
    dir_path = dir_path == "" and item.name or (dir_path .. "/" .. item.name)
    refresh_list(true)
    return
  end

  -- 小应用缓存（c_ 前缀，无扩展名）：读一次后按内容分流，P4 当图片、无 NUL 当文本
  if root_id == "dev" and is_cache_name(item.name) then
    local path = dir_path == "" and item.name or (dir_path .. "/" .. item.name)
    show_loading("文件管理器", "正在打开 " .. cache_label(item.name) .. "…")
    local body, err
    if fs then body, err = fs.read(path) end
    if not body then
      error_text = err or "读取失败（固件需 2.9.10 及以上）"
      view = "error"
      return
    end
    if body:sub(1, 2) == "P4" then
      image_pbm = body
      image_name = cache_label(item.name)
      view = "image"
    elseif not body:find(string.char(0), 1, true) then
      reader = { text = normalize_text(body), name = cache_label(item.name),
                 start = 1, next_at = 1, history = {} }
      view = "text"
    else
      error_text = "缓存内容不是文本或 PBM 图片"
      view = "error"
    end
    return
  end

  local ext = ext_of(item.name)
  if TEXT_EXT[ext] then
    local path = dir_path == "" and item.name or (dir_path .. "/" .. item.name)
    open_text(path, item.name)
  elseif IMAGE_EXT[ext] then
    local path = dir_path == "" and item.name or (dir_path .. "/" .. item.name)
    open_image(path, item.name)
  else
    error_text = "暂不支持这种文件：" .. (ext ~= "" and ext or "无扩展名")
    view = "error"
  end
end

local function draw_error()
  ui.clear()
  ui.title("文件管理器")
  ui.text(error_text, MARGIN, TOP + 70, TEXT_W)
  ui.footer("语音重试 · 电源退出")
end

function draw()
  if view == "home" then
    draw_home()
  elseif view == "list" then
    draw_list()
  elseif view == "text" then
    draw_text()
  elseif view == "image" then
    draw_image()
  elseif view == "info" then
    draw_info()
  elseif view == "confirm" then
    draw_confirm()
  elseif view == "del_confirm" then
    draw_del_confirm()
  elseif view == "msg" then
    draw_msg()
  else
    draw_error()
  end
end

-- 按键只更新状态：框架会在回调结束后统一调用 draw() 并做局部刷新，
-- 这里再主动 draw/flush 会造成双重刷新与整屏闪烁
function on_key(action)
  if view == "home" then
    if action == "prev" then
      sel = sel == 1 and #ROOTS or sel - 1
    elseif action == "next" then
      sel = sel == #ROOTS and 1 or sel + 1
    elseif action == "ok" then
      root_id = ROOTS[sel].id
      dir_path = ""
      crumbs = {}
      refresh_list(true)
    elseif action == "back" then
      sys.exit()
    end
    return
  end

  if view == "list" then
    if action == "prev" or action == "next" then
      if #entries == 0 then return end
      sel = sel + (action == "prev" and -1 or 1)
      if sel < 1 then sel = #entries end
      if sel > #entries then sel = 1 end
    elseif action == "ok" then
      open_entry()
    elseif action == "prev_long" then
      if #crumbs > 0 then
        dir_path = table.remove(crumbs)
        refresh_list(true)
      else
        dir_path = ""
        view = "home"
        sel = 1
      end
    elseif action == "next_long" then
      open_info()   -- 右长按：查看当前文件信息（壁纸 / 刷机 / 安装小应用）
    elseif action == "back" then
      sys.exit()
    end
    return
  end

  if view == "info" then
    if action == "prev" or action == "next" then
      if #info_actions > 0 then
        info_sel = info_sel + (action == "prev" and -1 or 1)
        if info_sel < 1 then info_sel = #info_actions end
        if info_sel > #info_actions then info_sel = 1 end
      end
    elseif action == "ok" then
      local act = info_actions[info_sel]
      if act then
        if act.kind == "wallpaper" or act.kind == "poweroff" then
          set_wallpaper(act.kind)
        elseif act.kind == "flash" then
          view = "confirm"   -- 刷机高危，先进确认页
        elseif act.kind == "delete" then
          view = "del_confirm"   -- 删除不可恢复，先进确认页
        elseif act.kind == "install" then
          install_app()
        elseif act.kind == "install_lua" then
          install_app_lua()
        end
      end
    elseif action == "prev_long" then
      view = "list"
    elseif action == "back" then
      sys.exit()
    end
    return
  end

  if view == "del_confirm" then
    if action == "ok" then
      do_delete()
    elseif action == "prev_long" then
      view = "info"
    elseif action == "back" then
      sys.exit()
    end
    return
  end

  if view == "confirm" then
    if action == "ok" then
      do_flash()
    elseif action == "prev_long" then
      view = "info"
    elseif action == "back" then
      sys.exit()
    end
    return
  end

  if view == "msg" then
    if action == "ok" or action == "prev_long" then
      view = info_item and "info" or "list"
    elseif action == "back" then
      sys.exit()
    end
    return
  end

  if view == "text" then
    if action == "prev" then
      turn_text(-1)
    elseif action == "next" or action == "ok" then
      turn_text(1)
    elseif action == "prev_long" or action == "back" then
      reader = nil
      view = "list"
    end
    return
  end

  if view == "image" then
    if action == "ok" or action == "prev_long" or action == "next_long" or action == "back" then
      image_pbm = nil
      view = "list"
    end
    return
  end

  -- 错误页：语音键回到当前目录重新读取
  if action == "ok" then
    refresh_list(true)
  elseif action == "prev_long" then
    dir_path = ""
    crumbs = {}
    view = "home"
    sel = 1
  elseif action == "back" then
    sys.exit()
  end
end
